normalization_rules: ER, PR, HER2, HER2 IHC/ISH, and Ki-67 are pathology special stain/IHC/ISH values, not routine laboratory exam values.
HER2 IHC 2+ must use ISH/FISH to determine summary HER2 status.
Preserve Ki-67 operators and ranges such as <5, <14, 5-14, >=20.
ypT or ypN should set post_nac_prefix=yes while storing clean pT/pN values.
Axillary surgery is multi-select; keep SLNB,TAD,ALND when all were performed.
No residual invasive carcinoma with residual DCIS only should map to post_nac_response=DCIS only and pT=Tis when applicable.
